chapters.title: Introducing deep learning and PyTorch
chapters.summary: Orient yourself: what deep learning changes, why PyTorch is a practical fit, and how notebooks support an experimental workflow.

chapters.title: Pretrained networks
chapters.summary: Run useful models before training your own, then inspect image classifiers, generative models, model hubs, and MNIST.

chapters.title: Tensors
chapters.summary: Build intuition for shape, dtype, storage, indexing, broadcasting, and named dimensions—the vocabulary used by every later model.

chapters.title: Representing real-world data
chapters.summary: Turn images, volumetric scans, tables, time series, text, audio, and video into tensors a model can consume.

chapters.title: The mechanics of learning
chapters.summary: Derive parameter estimation, automatic differentiation, and optimizer-driven learning from small, inspectable examples.

chapters.title: Neural networks
chapters.summary: Move from hand-written functions to reusable modules, nonlinear activations, parameters, and composable network classes.

chapters.title: Learning from images
chapters.summary: Create datasets and train a first image classifier that distinguishes birds from airplanes.

chapters.title: Convolutions
chapters.summary: Use local receptive fields, channels, pooling, and deeper convolutional architectures to improve image models.

chapters.title: Language models and transformers
chapters.summary: Explore tokenization, attention, vision transformers, and autoregressive name generation.

chapters.title: Diffusion and image generation
chapters.summary: Follow noise forward, learn the reverse process, construct U-Net and transformer denoisers, and sample generated data.

chapters.title: Medical imaging project
chapters.summary: Frame the end-to-end lung-cancer project: raw CT data, candidate detection, classification, segmentation, evaluation, and operational constraints.

chapters.title: Loading and exploring CT data
chapters.summary: Parse LUNA metadata, map physical coordinates to voxels, crop 3D candidates, cache expensive work, and inspect volumes.

chapters.title: Training a nodule classifier
chapters.summary: Build a 3D convolutional classifier, organize train/validation splits, run the optimization loop, and record metrics.

chapters.title: Improving classification
chapters.summary: Address class imbalance, augmentation, precision, recall, and F1 while inspecting how data choices affect performance.

chapters.title: Segmentation and foundation models
chapters.summary: Apply Segment Anything to CT slices, create masks and prompts, fine-tune the model, and run inference.

chapters.title: Distributed training
chapters.summary: Scale beyond one process with process groups, collectives, DDP, model and pipeline parallelism, device meshes, and FSDP.

chapters.title: Optimization and deployment
chapters.summary: Compile, profile, quantize, export, serve, batch, stream, and prepare PyTorch models for edge and production targets.
